ar.label: Arabic
ar.next_action: None scheduled this campaign. Re-probe only if a future module gap or an engine-identified lead names a specific Arabic-language or Gulf-region source.
ar.reasoning: A native-Arabic query (epoxy marine anti-corrosion coating test data) surfaced exclusively commercial vendor/product pages (several from Chinese manufacturers exporting to Arabic-speaking markets, plus a test-chamber vendor) -- zero academic aggregator, national standards body, or research-institute domain in 6 results. This is a single-query probe, not an exhaustive search: Gulf-region materials science (Saudi KACST, UAE research centers) publishes predominantly in English in international journals, which is consistent with the absence of a distinct native Arabic-language academic repository surfacing here. Excluded from this campaign's active language-community list on this fire's evidence; not proven permanently absent -- a differently-worded query or a named Gulf research institute (e.g. KACST, ADNOC R&D) could still surface real activity in a future fire.

hi.label: Hindi
hi.next_action: None scheduled this campaign. If a future fire identifies a named Indian national repository (e.g. CSIR-NML technical reports, Shodhganga thesis repository) it should be evaluated directly rather than via a language-community query, since the evidence indicates the relevant literature is English-language.
hi.reasoning: The native-Devanagari query hit a transient WebSearch tool error (disclosed, not retried a third time). A follow-up query explicitly biased toward Indian/Hindi sourcing ('...Hindi language materials science journal भारत') returned exclusively international English-language publisher venues (Springer, Wiley, ScienceDirect, Emerald) -- zero Hindi-language or India-national-repository domain in 8 results. India has real corrosion/materials-science research capacity (CSIR-NML, National Institute of Oceanography) but the evidence here indicates that capacity publishes in English in international venues rather than in a distinct Hindi-language repository, which is a genuine, checked finding, not an assumption. Excluded from this campaign's active language-community list on this fire's evidence.

sv.label: Swedish
sv.next_action: Open a DR-LANG-SV item (or fold into a future DR-LANG-EU2-class fire) for a full gap-targeted native-Swedish sweep: DiVA thesis titles, SIS (Swedish Institute for Standards) EN ISO 12944/9227 adoption, RISE technical reports.
sv.reasoning: A first native-language query surfaced only commercial boat-epoxy vendor pages. A second, repository-targeted query (DiVA portal + avhandling/thesis terms) confirmed live, indexed academic infrastructure: diva-portal.org and kth.diva-portal.org serve full-text thesis PDFs, and RISE (Research Institutes of Sweden) maintains a named 'Marin korrosion' (marine corrosion) expertise area. Sweden has a real, distinct national repository class (DiVA) and a marine-industrial research base (RISE, Chalmers-adjacent shipbuilding heritage) that the directive's 'extends wherever research indicates activity' clause covers. NOT excluded: this is a genuine extension candidate, deferred to a future DR-LANG-SV fire because no gap-targeted native-Swedish sweep (JIS/DIN-analogue Swedish standards body SIS, specific DiVA thesis titles, RISE technical reports) has been run yet this campaign.

orphan_detection_audit.attack_shape: Strip one repository's query log from a copy and attack whether the audit detects a ledger entry with no matching search provenance; check the extension decisions exist and are reasoned.

positive_control.evidence: run_orphan_checker() against the mutated copy returned violation_count=1, refutation_criterion_fired=True, flagging DR-LANG-DE-DSL-01 (language=de) as having no matching search provenance once its search-record line was stripped -- exactly the defect class this checker exists to catch. Against the REAL (unmutated) assembled search-record, the same checker returned violation_count=0 both replay runs (byte-identical diagnostic, sha256 5a557f3a0137b51e9c6d9ea68e4c35d2f0930b98a30d1eb3264deb63fe35f3cd).
positive_control.how_planted: copy.deepcopy() of the in-memory line list, then list.pop() on the one line whose fire_id matched the DR-LANG-DE fire; the real search-record.v1.jsonl file on disk is untouched by this mutation.
positive_control.planted_defect: Removed the entire DR-LANG-DE search-record.v1.jsonl line (fire_id 20260810T080001-2919803-f979e09ce9dd, language_communities_touched=['de']) from a COPY of the assembled search-record lines. The real on-disk ledger was never touched.
